steps.help: Step 1 of 6: The User Management page shows all users in the system. You can search, filter, and sort users from here.
Step 2 of 6: Use the search box to find a specific user by name or email. You can also use filters to narrow down the list.
Step 3 of 6: Click the edit icon (pencil) next to the user you want to modify. This opens the user edit form.
Step 4 of 6: You can update the user's name, email, role, and password. Changes take effect immediately after saving.
Step 5 of 6: Add or remove countries for Focal Points. Administrators automatically have access to all countries.
Step 6 of 6: Click "Save Changes" to apply your updates. The user will be notified if their access has changed.
